english: Is that the cry of the higurashi...?\nEarly summer in Japan - June, I wonder.
For now, let's head out to the main road.
//BG: Hinamizawa (day)
Whoa, talk about the boonies!
Mmm, delicious.\nYou can really tell the air itself has flavor.
Doctor Death's hideout is in a place like this?\nKinda hard to believe.
A mysterious figure in a secluded Western-style mansion -\nthat's a classic setup.
Doesn't even look like there's a mansion here!\nLike, "Doctor Death is hiding in that watermill" -\nthat's a joke, right?!
But there's no mistaking that Doctor Death came here.\nHe's gotta be somewhere.
True. For now we need to gather\ninformation about this land.
There's a place name on the sign.\nLet's see... Hi-na-mi-za-wa?
Hello.
Everyone's wearing weird clothes...\nYou're not from the village, right?\nTraveling, kana? Kana?
Yes, we just arrived.\nAre you from this village?
Yes. I'm Rena - Ryugu Rena.
Hm? What's wrong, kana? Kana?
Nothing... it's nothing. Nothing at all.
Huh? Rena, who're these people? Friends?
Ah, Mii-chan!
Howdy. Rena's bosom friend,\nSonozaki Mion, at your service.\nThank you for looking after our girl~.
Our girl?
Yeah, I'm the club president, you see.\nClub member Rena is like my own child!\n...Though it'd hurt if she got in my eye.
They said they came traveling.
Ah, it's that season, huh.
Say, since we're at it, how about\nwe show you around Hinamizawa?\nThe "Watanagashi" festival is tomorrow anyway.
The "Watanagashi" festival?
Huh? You came traveling, so\nyou came to see tomorrow's "Watanagashi," right?
We are...
Yes! That's what we came to see!
Aria-chan?
(Just play along with me!)
Right? The stalls aren't out today yet,\nso you must be bored. That's why\nwe'll show you Hinamizawa's famous spots.
Hauu!! That sounds great!\nI'm taking all of you home!!
Dunno what's going on, but sure, why not?
Sure. Let's take the tour.
Leave it to meee!
Let's go! Let's go!
//Rena and Mion go off-screen.
(Aria-chan,\nwe didn't come here to play...)
(I know.\nJust leave it to me for now)
(That's fine, but...)
//BG: Hinamizawa branch school (day)
This is the Hinamizawa branch school we attend.\nThe only school in the village.
It's tiny!?
It's tiny!?
Then let me introduce my classmates.\nHeey, Rika-chan, Satoko!
What is it, Mion-san?
Mii~?
Aren't they cute~?\nRika-chan and Satoko-chan.\nThey're precious club members too.
Classmates!?\nThey clearly aren't your age!
(Coming from Aria-san, that's not convincing...)
Ah, it's a small school so\nall students are in the same class.\nThere's only one teacher, too.
Wow, schools like this exist!
And who might you be?
They're here to see the "Watanagashi" festival.\nBy a twist of fate, we're showing them\naround the village's famous spots.
This school is a famous spot?
It's unusual for city folks, you know. Nipa~.
True. This small, it is unusual.
Right?\nWell, now that the club members are all here,\nlet's do club!
Club?
Our club, you see,\nto cope with an increasingly complex society\nunder various conditions...
It's a club where everyone plays games together.
Hey, Rika-chan, that summary was too fast!
A super chill club, huh.
Wrong! Club rule number one: aim for first place only!\nSloppy play like "it's just for fun" is not allowed!
Club rule number two!\nTo that end, putting in every effort\nis mandatory.
Well, slacking off wouldn't be fun, right?
The punishment games are mercilessly harsh too.
So what do you do in this club?
You'll see soon!
//BG: in front of Furude Shrine (day)
This is called Furude Shrine.\nProbably the place with the best view, kana?
Furude Shrine, so that means...
Mii~. I'm the shrine maiden here, you know.
Tomorrow's "Watanagashi" festival star is\nRika-chan, performing the dedication dance\nas the shrine maiden.
What a cute shrine maiden!
Hauu! I wanna take her home!!
No way!\nMore importantly, it's club time here!
What are we doing?
We're all eating lunch together!!\nBut it's not just any lunch!
//Event CG: Mion feeding Aria lunch with an "ahhn." A suspiciously nice smile (obviously a viciously bitter trap)
Aria, do you like tamagoyaki?
I don't hate it, particularly?
I see, I see.\nThen, here, ahhn.
Huh?\nWh-wh-why?
It's ritual, ritual!\nThis is how we deepen our friendship!
Ugh... a-ahhn.
Nmu... mugu mugu.\nBuhah!???
Aria-chan!?
Oh my?\nTo draw the super-spicy Russian tamagoyaki\non the first try - what luck!
Mugugu, water, water!
Here, water, you know~.
Gok, gok!
Buhaaa, spiiicy!!
O~hohohohoho!\nYou fell for it, Aria-san!
Fell for it or not,\nyou just shoved it in my mouth!
Wrong! If you chow down with zero caution,\nyou can't survive this harsh modern society!
Indeed! If Aria-san were a fish,\nshe'd be the first caught\nand turned into sashimi!
Sheesh, that's too much.\nAria-chan's a guest, you know.
It's fine. Better than only remembering\nthis as a boring backwater with nothing in it!
Please don't be mad at me, Aria.
I lost even the will to be mad, it was so spicy!\nWhere in this land did you get\nsuper-spicy spices!?
Right, you'd think at most you'd get\nmustard paste or chili oil, no?
Fufufu, that carelessness is what gets you killed.
You dig a pitfall where you'd least expect one -\nthe basics and essence of traps.
Traps?
Satoko's a trap master, you know~.
An elementary schooler, and traps...
I told you!\nWe do club to cope with\nan increasingly complex modern society.
Mion-san and Rena-san show no mercy\nto me or Rika, either.\nIt's wisdom and technique for survival!
Haha... being told that by an elementary schooler,\neven Aria can't stay mad...
(Ugh... so frustrating!)
//Event CG off
Man, this is fun!\nIt's been a while since I laughed from the bottom of my belly.\nSay, why don't you just live in Hinamizawa?
Ahaha! That sounds fun!
Come to think of it,\nhow long are you Aria-people staying in Hinamizawa?
...About that,\nwe're actually not traveling.
Huh?
(Aria-chan...?)
We came to this Hinamizawa\nchasing a criminal from Tokyo.
If I didn't say it,\nit'd be like I lied.\nThis is the truth.
Mii~.
Has anything changed in this village lately?\nLike seeing a suspicious person.
Nothing.
Nothing in particular, kana? Kana?
...Even if not recently, then?
Nope.
I-I see...?
Then that's fine!\nSorry for asking weird stuff!
Yeah, don't worry about it!\nWe've never been asked stuff like that,\nso we're surprised too.
Say! Won't you stay at my place tonight?\nAs the finale of the famous-spot tour,\nI'll invite you to the Sonozaki house.
Mion's house?\nBut there's this many of us...
Mii-chan's house is one of the Three Families of Hinamizawa -\na grand estate of a distinguished family.
It's what you'd call an old traditional house -\na different flavor from modern buildings, I think?\nYou could call it a famous spot, I'd say.
Okay, then we'll take you up on it.
You're welcome.\nNow that we've finished lunch,\nlet's go!
(Aria-chan, is it okay to decide that fast?)
(I haven't let my guard down, leave it to me...)
//Fade to black, to the next day
Wow, what an amazing house!\nIt's wooden but looks sturdy -\nlooks like it'll last another hundred years easy!
True.
Rin-chan, nothing unusual happened\nduring our stay at the Sonozaki house, right?
Just people working on festival preparations,\nnothing else.
I see... well, that's fine.
//SE: higurashi cicadas crying
People are gathering.\nLooks like it's almost festival time.
Oh, villagers are streaming along.\nIs it festival time soon?
Well, from here on.
We have to stay on guard\nfor whether Doctor Death shows up...
Everyone go to the festival with Rena and them.\nI'll act alone.
What's that? What are you planning?
You have something in mind?
Sorry,\nall I can say right now is it's my gut.\nBut I feel like I have to.
Fine, but\nif it gets dangerous, shoot right away, okay?\nThen I'll find you.
Got it.\nYou be careful too.
//BG: woods (night)
Rika's dedication dance is almost time...
I made a round, and\nall the villagers gathered at the festival -\nnobody anywhere else...
//SE: sound of walking through bushes with a rustle
...Hm? Is someone there?
(Seems to be sneaking off somewhere.\nI'll tail them...)
//Fade to black\n//BG: woods (night)\n//SE: sound of walking through bushes with a rustle
(Hm... they should be near here, but...?)
...Who are you?
Mion!?
Why are you in a place like this?
That's my line!\nI heard footsteps,\nso I wondered where you were going...
No way!? N-n-night crawling...?
Um, you seem to be\nmisunderstanding a lot of things, but...
Hmm... well, whatever.
Wanna come along?\nI'll show you something interesting.
//BG: in front of the ritual storehouse (night)
Is this the Furude Shrine's storehouse?
It's the never-opened ritual storehouse.\nOnly the Furude family and a handful of people\nare allowed inside.
It's a forbidden sanctuary, because anyone\nbut the Furude family would bring in impurity, they say.
Sounds interesting, right?\nWanna go in?
...Why are you inviting me?
Don't tell me you're not interested.\nWandering around instead of joining\nthe "Watanagashi" festival means that's what it's about, right?
Mgh...
//Event CG: Shion sneaking into the ritual storehouse
I'm a Sonozaki, after all.\nI can pretty much guess\nwhat's in here.
Hey, can you open this padlock?
Why are you asking me?
I figured you'd be\nfaster than me.
...Fine.
//SE: sound of the lock being removed
That was fast! Well, shall we go in!
//SE: footsteps opening the door and going in\n//BG: black background
Wh-what is this...
That's Hinamizawa's guardian deity,\nOyashiro-sama.
Oyashiro-sama...?
Say, do you know what\n"Watanagashi" means?
Huh...
Haha... they say the people living in this village\nhave half-demon blood flowing in them.
Occasionally that man-eating demon blood awakens,\nand they'd go down to the village and "demon away" people.
Onikakushi...?
It means abducting sacrifices.\nAnd to deliciously devour the poor victims,\nthe "Watanagashi" ritual was performed.
See, don't they say "wata"? For innards.
Wata as in, guts?
Exactly.\nThe hoe Rika-chan holds in the ritual\nis for prying open human bellies.
Here, look around.
(This ritual storehouse is full of nothing but dissection tools...!)
I'd heard the stories too, but\nthis is the first time seeing the real thing.\nThey really were all used, huh.
Just asking to be sure,\nthat's a story from long ago, right?
Some people think Oyashiro-sama's curse\nstill exists...
Oyashiro-sama's curse?
Onikakushi. After the Watanagashi festival,\none person dies, and one person vanishes.
A curse… You think someone's actually doing this?
…You think so too?
We should head back soon.\nRika-chan's ceremonial dance will be over by now,\nand everyone's down at the river floating cotton.
So, keep tonight a secret for me, okay?\nIf they find out we snuck in,\nwe won't get off easy.
Got it.
The ritual storehouse is sacred ground,\nso bringing impurity in there…\nOyashiro-sama might curse us, y'know?
Still… what WAS that noise?
Huh? Noise… what noise?
The noise! That whole clatter-bang racket-\nyou heard how loud it was, right?
Huh? I didn't hear any noise.\nInside the storehouse it was\ncreepily quiet, wasn't it?
You're kidding me, right!?
No way… you're lying… no…
Hehe, hahaha! Bwahahaha!!\nGotcha! It was all a lie!!
Hey!! You little-!!
Na-na-na-na-na! You fell for it!
What WAS that all about…
Fwaah… that post-festival hangover thing.\nThis tiredness just won't go away…
Aria, mooorning!
…Oh, Mion.\nMorning.
Mind if I ask you something?
What?
Last night… you didn't run into Shion, did you?
Huh…? Who's Shion?
Shion's my twin sister.\nYou didn't see her yesterday?
(A twin!? So the one I thought was Mion\nlast night… was her twin sister…!?)
That face says you did meet her, doesn't it?
N-no…
The ritual storehouse's lock was jimmied…\nLooks like somebody broke in.
You know about Oyashiro-sama's curse, right?\nSo you know what that means… right?
Yeah… that's all. Later.
…I think I've got the gist of it.
This village is way more messed up than I imagined…
Onikakushi-one disappears, one dies…\nI'm betting it's human work.
So someone's using the legends and customs\nto commit murders and kidnappings?
And the whole village might be\ncovering it up…
So it looks like Oyashiro-sama's curse targets\npeople like me.
And Mion-chan's little sister, Shion-chan.
Like hell I'm getting done in\nby some phony trick like that!
I'll go in alone as bait\nand lure the culprit out. The rest…
Leave it to me. I'll stick to you as your bodyguard.
I'm counting on you.\nI'm NOT dying in a place like this!
Obviously!
(Still… I wonder if Dr. Shinigami is involved in this.\nI can't sense any movement from him at all… it's unnerving…)
Aria went toward the shrine, indeed.\nWe should follow her, indeed.
Looks like Aria headed for the shrine.\nAlright, we should-
Oh my, everyone's together.\nWhere are you all off to?
Mion-chan!?
Before that, there's something\nI'd like to ask you about…
…If you're standing in our way,\nthen you're involved in the Onikakushi, aren't you?
It's Oyashiro-sama's curse.
That's why I'm saying maybe YOU guys\nare the ones doing it!
Wouldn't know.
Oyashiro-sama's curse…\nThey can't move easily by day…\nIf something happens, it'll be at night.
Come to think of it, what happened to Shion, I wonder?\nShe hasn't already…?
Aria-chan!
Rena!?
Please, help!
What!
Rika-chan and Satoko-chan are going to be killed!!
What did you say!?
Satoko Houjou… the cursed child\nstruck by Oyashiro-sama's curse…
The Houjou family was swallowed by a fate of death,\nyet you alone get forgiven…!
Unforgivable, unforgivable, unforgivable,\nunforgivable, UNFORGIVABLE…!
Wh-whatever do you mean…?\nWhatever is the matter with you, Mion-san…!?
Mii, come back to your senses!
You're next, Rika… The Three Families all die!!
But if I kill you here,\nI'd miss out on the fun of torturing you…
I'll invite you down to the basement torture room-\nso much fun, fun, fun!
Rika! Satoko!!
Aria-san!?
I came to help!
Rena, what happened to Mii?
I don't know… maybe Oyashiro-sama's…
Rena, stop thinking like that!\nWhen people do something, there's always a motive!\nI'll grab Mion and make her confess-get ready!
No way! Why don't YOU\nstop scurrying around and drop dead!\nBy Oyashiro-sama's curse!!
Rena, did you know Mion\nwas like that?
No! Mii-chan isn't like that!\nShe's kind, and caring,\nand she treasures her friends!
You think too highly of her!\nMion Sonozaki is… a demon!
What's the matter? Is that okay?\nRika-chan and Satoko will die any moment now.
Mion, release Rika and Satoko right now\nand surrender!
Don't you dare spout such convenient crap!\nJust be a good girl and die by Oyashiro-sama's curse!
Rika-chan, Satoko-chan, hang in there!\nI'm coming!
I will NOT lose!
Just believe in the two of us-
Sorry I'm late!
Rena? Rika and Satoko are here too!?
Details later!\nSave Rika-chan and Satoko-chan!
Roger!!
Rem, what've you been doing all this time!
Mion-chan was holding me up… Huh?\nWhy is Mion-chan here!?
Hmm, I wonder why~
Now that the audience is gathered,\nlet's end this game.
This is!? A dream demon!!
Mion! You and Dr. Shinigami…!!
It's Oyashiro-sama's curse!\nThose who must die, die!\nAh-hahahahaha!!!!
She's lost it…!
Hang in there, Rika-chan! Satoko!
We refuse to lose!\nNot to the likes of you! Not like this!\nWe will never, ever lose!
Mii, doing this is pointless.
Oh is that right!\nWhether you lose, whether it's pointless-\nI'll show you myself!!
Mii…!
There… got you…!
Stop!!
Stop it, Mii-chan!
Goodbye.\nYou lot-keep THEM busy!!
Rika-chan! Satoko-chan!!
After her! No matter what!!
Now then, fun fun torture time!\nWhich one of you wants to die first?
Urgh…!
Let go of Satoko!
Shut up, you brat!
Urgh!?
Rika!!
…Sa…to…
What? You died already?\nThe Furude family just isn't satisfying!!\nEntertain me a little longer…
No, Rika… Rika… sob!
Satokoo~!\nYou're not gonna die right away, are you?\nYou'll let me hear plenty of screaming, won't you?
Nii-nii…
Shut UP!! If you'd just died sooner!\nSatoshi-kun wouldn't have had to suffer!!
I knew… Because of me,\nNii-nii has always…
Oh? So you knew? Surprising.
Guh…!! That's why I became strong-\nso I can show Nii-nii when he comes home\nthat I'm fine without his help!
He's never coming back!!\nSatoshi-kun-YOU killed him!!\nALL OF YOU killed him!!
I believe he will!! That's why!!
I won't cry! I won't call for help!\nLike I'd ever lose to someone like you!!\nNever!! Never!! Never!!
HYEAAAH-HA!!!!
Rika!! Satoko- huh!
Fufu, fu…
Ahaha, ahahahaha!!\nAh-hahahahaha!!!!
I won, I won…!\nI beat the ones who killed Satoshi-kun!!
Rika…? Satoko…?
Th-they're dead…!?
Fufufu… ah-hahahaha…!
A… ah…
Aria-chan…
How awful… awful…\nYou said you'd save them…
U… ah… no, I…
Why… why did it come to this…!
Why Rika-chan and Satoko-chan!
Why…?
I-I…!!\nIt's not me…!\nI…!! No!! Ngh!!
M-my throat…!! Haa, haa!!\nUuuuugh!! Aaaaah!!!
…ngh…
Finally awake?
…Mion?
That's right~\nI was thinking of letting you live…
Changed my mind!
//END
